item.description:
## Fixed
- Laban dragged from the disk image into Applications no longer reports "Laban is damaged and can't be opened". Two bundled theme files had accented names that Finder rewrites while copying, which invalidated the app's signature. This affected the 0.8.2 and 0.8.3 disk images.

## New
- **Ask before closing a running program.** Closing a pane, tab, or window, or quitting, now asks first when a program other than the shell is running, and names what will be ended ("vim is running and will be ended"). A pane at its shell prompt closes without asking. Closing a tab, window, or the app lists every busy pane in one dialog. Coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex are recognized, and the dialog says when one is in the middle of working. - Settings → "Ask before closing": When a program is running (default), Always, or Never, plus an editable list of programs that count as idle (shells, `tmux`, `screen`). - Quitting with background sessions and restore-on-launch on doesn't ask, because your sessions come back on the next launch.
## Changed
- **New sessions use grapheme-cluster width by default** (DEC mode 2027). A ZWJ emoji such as a technologist or a farmer now takes two columns instead of four. This keeps the screen aligned in programs that assume cluster width without asking for it, including Claude Code's fullscreen view, where a stale "Jump to bottom" pill or jumbled lines could otherwise appear. Choose "Legacy width" under Settings → Unicode width to restore the previous behavior; programs can still switch the mode themselves.
## Fixed
- Curly underlines now break around descenders (g, j, p, q, y), like the other underline styles. - An Indic conjunct split across two cells draws as one cluster, and later text on the line keeps its columns. - Thai SARA AM and clusters with Prepend characters no longer shift the rest of their row one column left. - A one-column emoji next to a blank cell draws at full two-column size instead of shrinking.

## New
- **Split panes.** ⌘D splits right and ⌘⇧D splits down, nested in any combination. Drag a divider to resize, or double-click it to equalize. ⌘⌥Arrows move focus between panes, ⌘⌃Arrows nudge a divider, ⌘⌃= equalizes, and ⌘⇧Return zooms the focused pane. Layouts survive restarts. - ⌘W now closes the focused pane (and the tab when it is the last one). ⌘⌥W always closes the tab. - **Paste screenshots into SSH sessions.** With an image on the clipboard, ⌘V in a pane running `ssh` uploads it to the same host and pastes the remote path, so Claude Code and Codex on the remote can see it. The first upload to each host asks for consent. - **Kitty clipboard protocol.** Programs that enable Kitty paste events (OSC 5522), such as `kitten clipboard`, can now read pasted images and text. - **Right-to-left text.** Arabic and Hebrew are shown in visual order, and Arabic letters join. - **Font ligatures** are on by default for programming fonts that have them. - OSC 52 copies from remote programs now show a confirmation toast.
## Faster
- Text rendering takes roughly half the GPU time it did, and much less with subpixel antialiasing. Steady-state frames no longer allocate. - Scrolling the sidebar is smooth.
## Fixed
- Restarting Laban no longer replays old OSC 52 copies over your clipboard or re-posts old notifications. - The character under a block cursor stays visible, and the cursor covers both columns of a wide character. - Box-drawing lines, braille and sextants join seamlessly between cells. - Text weight matches macOS rendering in both light and dark themes. - Fonts without bold or italic faces get synthesized bold and italic. - Underlines sit at the font's metrics, skip descenders, and keep dashed and dotted patterns continuous across color changes. - Combining marks and Indic clusters draw every glyph, and zero-width characters no longer shift the rest of the line. - Emoji and CJK keep drawing in long sessions instead of disappearing once the glyph atlas fills, and memory for glyph outlines is bounded. - Oversized fallback glyphs stay inside their cells, and single-width emoji no longer cover the next character. - `.otf` fonts draw curves accurately at large sizes. - Panes below a split no longer lose two rows to empty space under the titlebar.
